sources.expected_title: Comprehensive analysis of kinase inhibitor selectivity
DeepDTA: deep drug-target binding affinity prediction

claims.text: The original Davis study profiled kinase-inhibitor interactions across a broad kinase panel.
DeepDTA describes binding-affinity prediction from compound and protein sequence representations.

links.rationale: The source reports the Davis kinase-inhibitor profiling study used to contextualize this benchmark.
The source describes the DeepDTA affinity-prediction approach and its input representations.
